summary: Regression sweep on mobile Expo web preview after adding Storage Meter (My Courses) + Auto Offline prompt (/play) + moving boundsForCourse to src/lib/geo.ts. All 5 targeted flows PASS. /courses lists 3 cards with NEW COURSE, IMPORT, BROWSE PHILIPPINE COURSES, and PLAY/EDIT/SHARE/DELETE per card. Storage meter, SAVE ALL, per-card offline row, and Auto-Offline Alert are correctly INERT on web (offlineSupported=false) as designed. /play mounts rangefinder-screen with no crash and no errant alert. /ph-courses loads with sort/region chips (All 98, Metro Manila 10, Cavite/Laguna 14) working. No JS errors or white screens.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' -> boxShadow, 'textShadow*' -> textShadow). Cosmetic on web preview only; native still uses shadow* correctly. Non-blocking.
React Native Web deprecation warning ('props.pointerEvents' -> style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/play.tsx:463 (topBar pointerEvents='box-none').

critical_code_review_comments: offline.web.ts stub correctly exports offlineSupported=false and no-op impls for getOfflineUsage/clearAllOffline — the conditional guards in courses/index.tsx (line 197) and play.tsx (line 132) correctly hide/skip the meter and Alert. Good design.
boundsForCourse in src/lib/geo.ts is pure JS with sane fallbacks (~2.2km box) when a course has <2 mapped points — safe to call on web without triggering native map deps.

Auto-Offline Alert in play.tsx writes to sg_offline_prompted BEFORE showing the Alert, so a user who dismisses via 'Not now' will still not be re-prompted. That matches the 'ask once per course' intent stated in the PRD.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing seeded courses (Apo Highlands Demo, Southpacific Golf and Leisure, Manila Golf & Country Club).
